dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent O-shaped structures in the mid-dorsal region exhibit sharp high-contrast perimeters with a step-gradient transition from low-intensity exterior pixels to high-intensity interior pixels. An additional C-shaped structure is visible laterally with a more diffused gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High-intensity pixel clusters are distributed with increasing spatial density towards the posterior-lateral region, characterized by irregular boundaries and uniform high-luma cores without internal variation.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three primary mid-dorsal macro-annuli define an obtuse triangle. The distance between the two most anterior centroids is approximately half the distance between the posterior centroid and the mid-point of the anterior pair.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex network of high-contrast, linear-to-curvilinear pixel chains forms a reticulated topology across the posterior quadrant of the visible subject surface.
